title: 第15章 抢亲第16章 愿不愿意跟我走
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
与此同时。
姜成益家。
妆房内。
“小姐，您真的要嫁给那姜成益吗？我听说他不过是姜族的第十序列候补，还有不少竞争者呢，而且您不是喜欢林宏炎吗？”
一名眉清目秀的侍女低声问道，为虞映雪梳妆。
虞映雪的容颜冷艳，气质沉郁，眉间似有深深的忧愁。
她是虞家家主长女，虞家虽为一方古族，二流不朽势力，在外界也颇具威名。
但在底蕴浩瀚如海的长生仙族姜家面前，只能用蝼蚁憾天来形容。
“不想嫁又如何？此等联姻之事，不是我能左右的。”
“若是悔婚失约，姜族是不会善罢甘休的。”
虞映雪语气低沉，轻启朱唇。
难免露出一丝无奈。
这门婚事，其实是他父亲为了巴结姜族主动联姻的，根本由不得她拒绝。
若是她在此刻任性，虞家怕是要遭到毁灭性的报复。
虽然姜成益只是姜家外围分脉，但再小的枝叶，也依旧是根连姜族的存在，若是闹出了乱子，惊动了主脉之人，那就悔之晚矣了。
……
大殿外，整个府邸上空悬挂着万盏红灯，流光溢彩，霞光漫天，烘托出喜庆而庄严的氛围。
仙乐悠扬，氛围祥和而隆重。
沿路台阶两侧，衣袂飘飘的女修依次而行，皆面容姣好、气质婉约，手中花篮内盛满珍稀灵花花瓣，光辉流转，宛若瑶池仙花。
伴随着她们婀娜的步伐，花瓣如雨般撒落。

空中弥漫着一股奇异的芳香。
令人陶醉。
每隔一段距离，设有一处白玉石筑成的高台，其上摆满了精致灵食与佳酿，灵气蒸腾，香气扑鼻。
各方宾客云集而来，或笑谈风雅，或低语推杯。
场面气氛热闹非凡。
一在一处偏僻的平台上，林宏炎坐在角落的桌旁，毫不顾及形象，正大快朵颐地享受着美食和灵酒。
只见他手持兽腿，嘴角油光闪亮，一边大嚼一边咕哝自语，丝毫未察觉旁人异样的目光。
“不就是一外围支脉么？就连待客的灵酒宴食都这般丰盛，对修士乃是大补之品，有顿悟之效…”
“这要是在外界，只怕一些大家族都拿不出来！
狗大户！”
“长生仙族姜家？呵呵！
这些迟早都是我林宏炎的！”
林宏炎面露得意之色，嘴里塞得满满的，双眼眯缝中闪着贪婪的光芒。
周围宾客纷纷侧目，不禁摇头叹息。
因为他们还从未见过如此粗鄙之人。
宴席尚未开始，灵酒一杯又一杯的续，抓着桌上的宴食就胡吃海塞，狼吞虎咽，吃相极为难堪，跟个饿死鬼投胎一般。
没见过世面的土鳖。
一旁身穿紫纹道袍的老者也终于看不下去了，眉头紧蹙，压低声音训斥道：“林宏炎！
注意你的言行举止！
这可是姜族的宴席，不是你乡下赶集！”

他乃是紫霄丹宗的大长老药元。
今日前来赴宴，是自家这个徒弟要求的。
林宏炎没有说要来干嘛，但药元能猜个八九不离十。
虞映雪那丫头他也见过，知道跟自己这徒弟关系匪浅，情愫颇深，而今却要嫁于他人，怎会甘心？
content_en:
at the same time.
Jiang Chengyi's family.
In the dressing room.
"Miss, do you really want to marry that Jiang Chengyi? I heard that he is just a candidate for the tenth rank of the Jiang clan. There are many competitors. And don't you like Lin Hongyan?"
A maid with delicate features asked in a low voice as she dressed Yu Yingxue.
Yu Yingxue has a cold face, a gloomy temperament, and there seems to be a deep sadness between her eyebrows.
She is the eldest daughter of the head of the Yu family. Although the Yu family is an ancient clan and a second-rate immortal force, it is also quite prestigious in the outside world.
But in front of the Jiang family, the Immortal Immortal Clan, whose heritage is as vast as the sea, it can only be described as an ant regretting the sky.
"So what if you don't want to get married? This kind of marriage is not something I can control."
"If you regret your marriage and break your promise, the Jiang clan will not let it go."
Yu Yingxue spoke in a low tone and opened her red lips lightly.
It is inevitable to show a trace of helplessness.
This marriage was actually initiated by his father in order to curry favor with the Jiang clan, and there was no way she could refuse.
If she is willful at this moment, the Yu family may suffer devastating revenge.
Although Jiang Chengyi is only a peripheral branch of the Jiang family, no matter how small the branches and leaves are, they are still connected to the Jiang family. If trouble occurs and the people in the main line are alarmed, it will be too late to regret it.
…
Outside the main hall, tens of thousands of red lanterns were hung over the entire mansion, shining brightly and filling the sky with glow, creating a festive and solemn atmosphere.
The music is melodious and the atmosphere is peaceful and solemn.
On both sides of the steps along the road, female cultivators in fluttering robes walked one after another, all with beautiful faces and graceful temperaments. The flower baskets in their hands were filled with petals of rare spiritual flowers, which were shining like fairy flowers in a fairyland.
With their graceful steps, petals fell like rain.
A strange fragrance filled the air.
Intoxicating.
At regular intervals, there is a high platform made of white jade, which is filled with exquisite spiritual food and wine. The spiritual energy is steaming and the aroma is fragrant.
Guests from all over the world gathered, laughing and chatting elegantly, or whispering and drinking glasses.
The atmosphere was lively.
Once on a remote platform, Lin Hongyan was sitting at the table in the corner, enjoying delicious food and spiritual wine without caring about his image.
I saw him holding the animal leg, his mouth shiny, chewing and mumbling to himself, without noticing the strange looks from others.
"Isn't it just a peripheral branch? Even the spiritual wine and banquet for entertaining guests are so rich. It is a great tonic for monks and has the effect of enlightenment..."
"If this were outside, I'm afraid some big families wouldn't be able to come up with it!
Big dog owner! "
"The Jiang family of the Immortal Clan? Haha!
Sooner or later these will all belong to me, Lin Hongyan! "
Lin Hongyan had a proud look on his face, his mouth was full, and his eyes were narrowed with greedy light.
The surrounding guests looked sideways, shaking their heads and sighing.
Because they have never seen such a vulgar person.
The banquet has not yet begun, and one glass after another of spiritual wine is poured out. They grab the food on the table and eat it without any hesitation. They look extremely embarrassed while eating, as if they were reincarnated as a starving ghost.
A country bumpkin who has never seen the world.
The old man wearing a purple-patterned Taoist robe beside him finally couldn't stand it anymore, he frowned and scolded in a low voice: "Lin Hongyan!
Watch your words and actions!
This is a banquet for the Jiang clan, not your country fair! "
He is Yaoyuan, the great elder of Zixiao Dan Sect.
Coming to the banquet today was requested by my disciple.
Lin Hongyan didn't say why he came, but Yao Yuan could guess pretty well.
He has also seen that girl Yu Yingxue. He knows that she has a close relationship and deep affection with his apprentice, but now she wants to marry someone else. How can he be willing to do so?
